title: (RHBA-2014:1017) s390utils enhancement update
portal_summary:
Updated s390utils packages that add one enhancement are now available for Red
Hat Enterprise Linux 7.

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via the Red Hat Network. Details on how to
use the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
https://access.redhat.com/site/articles/11258
portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user space utilities that should be used
together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

This update adds the following enhancement:

* A number of enhancements have been implemented for the dbinfo.sh file,
optimizing script execution and data collection, and expanding the range of
collected data with the journald logs, as well as with network and processor
details. (BZ#1122635)

Users of s390utils are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which add
this enhancement.
